bibl.title: Forme e riusi della consolatio nell'Apoteosi di Poppea (P.Oxy. LXXVII 5105).
bibl.seg: Sergio Audano, Forme e riusi della consolatio nell'Apoteosi di Poppea (P.Oxy. LXXVII 5105).
bibl.note: P. Oxy. LXXVII, 5105 (= MP3 1984.27; LDAB 140274). - Proposes a reading of the Apotheosis of Poppaea from the perspective of consolatory literature, in particular its rhetorical structure and its specific lexicon. The conclusion is that it is not a consolatio ad Neronem, but an occasional writing: the author (perhaps Leonides of Alexandria, as recently proposed) knows and adapts the rhetorical rules of consolation.
